title: Give Me 19 Minutes, and You’ll Become a Recruiting Machine
summary: A network-marketing trainer's recruiting method: a 20-person hit list, casual daily conversations, income and product stories, curiosity scripts and persistent follow-up.

assertions.quote: how you can be a recruiting machine and finally create the leverage that you need inside of your network marketing business
The fortune's in the followups. Most people will join after the fifth touch point.
network marketers are just storytellers. They're storytellers. They're problem solvers
You don't need an unbelievable milliondoll a year story in order for it to have power.
the more nos and the more rejection I get, the stronger my character. And the stronger my character, the bigger the income.
if you can identify the right people to move forward with, you will crush it. You will recruit like crazy
